decision.summary: Two regions stand out: (1) a complex multi-sample transition in the 485–544 window involving rising then falling N/E with U modulation, possibly indicating superposed motion or partial return; (2) a sustained E elevation from ~610–640 in the 605–664 window without a matching counter-change, warranting closer inspection for offset or platform behavior.

regions.observation: Cross-axis shape shows a multi-sample rise in N and E (e.g. indices ~490–505), followed by a plateau with elevated N/E and fluctuating U; later, a sharp drop in N (~530) coincides with a modest E decrease and U increase—suggesting possible opposing return or superposed offset.

Prominent upward shift in E (from ~5 to >6) around index 610–620, accompanied by a concurrent U dip and N increase; the E platform persists through ~640, then declines gradually—ambiguous whether this is a temporary offset or part of a longer trend, with no clear symmetric return within window.
